item.title: Officers, civilian recognized for rescue of Michigan ice fisherman
item.description: Nearly two years ago, a 63-year-old ice angler struggled for his life on Michigan’s Lake Gogebic, repeatedly falling into the icy surface. A team from several Michigan agencies worked together to rescue Paul Boehm during the March 12, 2024 incident. Earlier this month, five individuals received awards at a Michigan DNR meeting during the Sagola Township Sportsmen’s Club in Dickinson County. item.description: Snow crunched under my boots as my son Jason and I hiked across a plowed field toward a wooded valley in southeast Minnesota. item.title: Ice fishing for Minnesota lake trout… where patience actually pay off
item.description: Ice fishing for lake trout can feel intimidating, even to the initiated. They can cover miles of water in a day, swim 100 feet vertically in seconds, inhabit some of the biggest, deepest lakes around, and often humble even the most reliable rod-and-reel combos. That said, ice fishing for lakers is a pursuit that actually benefits the patient angler.
